title: Add benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v14 + representative runners and profiling baselines
author: Evan Brooks
description: Context: benchmark-lab needs consistent monthly reporting for representative workloads and up-to-date profiling baselines. This PR introduces Reporting Pipeline v14 which: aggregates per-model and per-route latency/cost histograms, merges profiling baselines from latest runs, and emits artifacts used by the console and perf dashboards. Motivation: previous pipeline v13 missed KV-cache-aware histograms and could not reconcile representative-run metadata. Changes include a new Airflow DAG, transforms to merge baseline JSONs, new representative workload runners for long-tail LLM scenarios, improved schema validation, and CI/integration tests. Checklist: - [x] Add v14 DAG and Airflow tasks - [x] Add representative workload runners (cpu/gpu configurations) - [x] Add baseline merge transform with stability heuristics - [x] Add integration tests and flaky-tolerant retries - [x] Update docs/README and example reports - [x] Run local end-to-end on dev cluster Notes: This is primarily additive and backwards-compatible with existing dashboards. Linked: ENG-4123 for baseline stability work. See docs link: https://redwood.ai/benchmark-lab/docs/reporting-v14
